svg.title: Smart home architecture on AWS
svg.desc: An ESP32 exchanges MQTT messages with AWS IoT Core. An IoT rule sends telemetry to a Lambda function that stores state in DynamoDB, writes CloudWatch metrics, raises SNS alerts and controls devices through the Device Shadow. Grafana reads CloudWatch. A watch app, through API Gateway and Cognito, and an Alexa skill use two more Lambda functions to read state and switch devices.
